snapshot.availability: The Hoodi activation previously scheduled for 2026-10-26 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132,352) remains postponed. No replacement epoch or timestamp is set; the planned 200M gas-limit increase remains removed. Mainnet activation remains unconfirmed.
features: gas-pricing changes intended to better reflect execution cost and state growth
snapshot.correction_note: The Ethereum Foundation update supersedes the earlier Hoodi schedule. Client release tables must not be treated as proof that a given client release includes the postponement unless its own release notes explicitly confirm it.

limitations: Roadmap is not proof of mainnet deployment.
entries.ARCHITECTURE_GAP: Potential governance check: bind activation state to explicit testnet, epoch/time, execution/consensus client versions and release-note evidence. A repository-level gap was not audited here.

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: No activation is treated as scheduled without an official epoch/time and client-version matrix.
Execution and consensus client release notes explicitly confirm the applicable network configuration.
Superseded activation dates are marked withdrawn and cannot remain active in operator guidance.
